result.citation: S.F. Admin. Code § 37.10C (as amended through Ord. No. 169-25)
result.citation_basis: § 37.10C: O040 (also D081, D002); Ord. No. 169-25 as latest amendment: O040
result.official_quote: It shall be unlawful for a landlord to use an algorithmic device described in subdivision (a) when setting rents or occupancy levels for residential dwelling units in San Francisco. Each separate month that a violation exists or continues, and each separate residential dwelling unit for which the landlord used the algorithmic device, shall constitute a separate and distinct violation.
result.note: Added 'as amended through Ord. No. 169-25' because the Rent Board's published text of the Rent Ordinance shows § 37.10C was added by Ord. No. 224-24 and last amended by Ord. No. 169-25. That text carries a Rent Board disclaimer that it is not the official record (American Legal is the official publisher), and the card's source D081 is a Rent Board news page, not the law's text.
